name: Jira
description: The Sumo Logic App for Jira provides insight into Jira usage, request activity, issues, security, sprint events, and user events.

children.name: Jira - Access
children.description: See information about Jira user access, including requests over time, average response times, issues by project, response codes, and errors.

panels.name: Jira Request Usage
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/jira
| parse regex "^(?<src_ip>[^\s]*) (?<jira_request_id>[^\s]*) (?<jira_username>[^\s]*) (?:[^\s]*\s){2}\"(?<method>[^\s]*) (?<uri>[^\s]*) (?<protocol>[^\"]*)\" (?<response_code>[^\s]*) (?<bytes>[^\s]*) \"(?<referrer>[^\"]*)\" \"(?<user_agent>[^\"]*)\"" nodrop
| parse regex "^(?<src_ip>[^\s]*) (?<jira_request_id>[^\s]*) (?<jira_username>[^\s]*) (?:[^\s]*\s){2}\"(?<method>[^\s]*) (?<uri>[^\s]*) (?<protocol>[^\"]*)\" (?<response_code>[^\s]*) (?<bytes>[^\s]*) (?<response_time>[^\s]*) \"(?<referrer>[^\"]*)\" \"(?<user_agent>[^\"]*)\" \"(?<jira_session_id>[^\"]*)\""  nodrop
| parse regex field=uri "/browse/(?<project>[^-]*)-(?<issue>\d+)" nodrop
| timeslice 5m
| count(uri) by _timeslice

| parse regex field=uri "/browse/(?<project>[^-]*)-(?<issue>\d+)" nodrop

| avg(response_time) by _timeslice

panels.name: Requests breakdown by Project

_sourceCategory = Labs/jira
| parse regex "^(?<src_ip>[^\s]*) (?<jira_request_id>[^\s]*) (?<jira_username>[^\s]*) (?:[^\s]*\s){2}\"(?<method>[^\s]*) (?<uri>[^\s]*) (?<protocol>[^\"]*)\" (?<response_code>[^\s]*) (?<bytes>[^\s]*) \"(?<referrer>[^\"]*)\" \"(?<user_agent>[^\"]*)\"" nodrop

panels.name: Requests by Project
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/jira
| parse regex "^(?<src_ip>[^\s]*) (?<jira_request_id>[^\s]*) (?<jira_username>[^\s]*) (?:[^\s]*\s){2}\"(?<method>[^\s]*) (?<uri>[^\s]*) (?<protocol>[^\"]*)\" (?<response_code>[^\s]*) (?<bytes>[^\s]*) \"(?<referrer>[^\"]*)\" \"(?<user_agent>[^\"]*)\"" nodrop

| parse regex field=uri "/browse/(?<project>[^-]*)-(?<issue>\d+)"
| where !isEmpty(issue)
| concat(project, "-", issue) as ticket
| count(ticket) as activity by project, issue, ticket
| fields ticket, activity
| sort by activity desc
| limit 25

children.name: Jira - Catalina
children.description: See information about Jiraâs internal web server, including errors, failures, and exceptions, requests over time, and top 15 URIs.

panels.name: Error/Failures/Exceptions Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/jira (error or fail* or exception)
| parse "* * * * * *" as date,time,module,severity,caller,msg nodrop
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice

panels.name: Number of Errors
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/jira (error or fail* or exception)
| count

panels.name: Requests Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/jira
| parse "URI *," as URI
| parse regex "\d{2}-\w{3}-\d{4}\s\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}.\d{3}\s(?<log_level>\w+)\s\[(?<thread>[^\]]+)\]\s(?<component>\S+)\s(?<message>.*)"
| timeslice 5m
| count _timeslice, log_level
| transpose row _timeslice column log_level

panels.name: Errors
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/jira 
| parse "* * * * * *" as date,time,module,severity,caller,msg
| where severity = "ERROR"
| count by date, module, msg
| sort by _count

panels.name: Top 15 URIs
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/jira
| parse "URI *," as URI
| parse regex "\d{2}-\w{3}-\d{4}\s\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}.\d{3}\s(?<log_level>\w+)\s\[(?<thread>[^\]]+)\]\s(?<component>\S+)\s(?<message>.*)"
| count uri
| sort _count
| limit 15

panels.name: Breakdown by Severity
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/jira  !(URI) !(*mail)  (INFO or WARN or FATAL or ERROR or DEBUG)
| parse "* * * * * *" as date,time,module,severity,caller,msg
| count by severity
| sort by _count

children.name: Jira - Issues
children.description: See information about issues in Jira, including issue types over time; a breakdown of issues by type; the top 10 issue creators and closers; issues closed vs. created over time; and unassigned issues.

panels.name: Issues by Type Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/jira  
| json  "webhookEvent","issue_event_type_name", "changelog", "user.emailAddress",  "issue.self","issue.key", "timestamp", "issue.fields.issuetype.name", "issue.fields.status.name",  "issue.fields.resolution.name",  "issue.fields.project.name" as event_name, event_type, change_log, user, jira_self, issue_key, timestamp, type, status, resolution, project_name
| json field=change_log "items" as changes
| formatDate(fromMillis(timestamp), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss") as date_time
| parse regex field=jira_self "(?<base_url>[\S]+\/jira)[\S]+" 
| concat(base_url,"/browse/", issue_key) as issue_url
| tourl(issue_url, issue_key) as issue
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice, type
| transpose row _timeslice column type
| fillmissing timeslice(1d)

panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/jira

| concat(base_url,"/browse/", issue_key) as issue_url
| tourl(issue_url, issue_key) as issue
| count by type
| sort by _count

panels.name: Issues Reopened

| json  "webhookEvent","issue_event_type_name", "changelog", "user.emailAddress",  "issue.self","issue.key", "timestamp", "issue.fields.issuetype.name", "issue.fields.status.name",  "issue.fields.resolution.name",  "issue.fields.project.name" as event_name, event_type, change_log, user, jira_self, issue_key, timestamp, type, status, resolution, project_name

| json field=change_log "items" as changes

panels.name: Unassigned Issues
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/jira  
| json  "webhookEvent","issue_event_type_name", "changelog", "user.emailAddress",  "issue.self","issue.key", "timestamp", "issue.fields.issuetype.name", "issue.fields.status.name",  "issue.fields.resolution.name",  "issue.fields.project.name", "issue.fields.assignee.name", "issue.fields.summary"  as event_name, event_type, change_log, user, jira_self, issue_key, timestamp, type, status, resolution, project_name, issue_assignee, issue_summary nodrop
| json field=change_log "items" as changes
| formatDate(fromMillis(timestamp), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss") as date_time
| parse regex field=jira_self "(?<base_url>[\S]+\/jira)[\S]+" 
| concat(base_url,"/browse/", issue_key) as issue_url
| tourl(issue_url, issue_key) as issue
| withtime issue_assignee 
| most_recent(issue_assignee_withtime) as user by issue, issue_summary
| where isNull(user)
| count by issue, issue_summary
| fields - _count

children.name: Jira - Overview
children.description: See an overview of activity in Jira, including the location of authentication events; one day time comparisons of logins, Jira requests, errors, errors over time, and data usage.

panels.name: Geo Location of Authentication Events
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/jira 
| parse regex ".* (?<ip>[\d]+.[\d]+.[\d]+.[\d]+) [\S]+ The user '(?<user>[\S]+)' has (?<result>PASSED|FAILED) authentication" 
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = ip
| count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code
| sort _count

| transpose row _timeslice column log_level
